name: Volumetric Lithograph
description: Psychedelic linocut terrain — forward-dollying flight over an infinite audio-reactive landscape. v9.4 routing: continuous terrain depth driven by stems.vocals_energy (AGC stem) only; peak lift fires on drum-stem kicks + snap/snare transients via drums_beat and drums_attack_ratio (MIR-invariant); camera dolly scales with features.bass continuously. Palette hue tracks energy-weighted stem composition; peak polish reads onset density. CSP.4 audit (2026-05-28) confirmed structurally clean of the FFO antipatterns BUG-019 fixed. No atmospheric fog (printmaking has no aerial perspective).
author: Matt
_comment_scene_fog: 0 disables fog (was actually MAXIMUM fog in pre-v3 due to PresetDescriptor+SceneUniforms fallback bug; fixed alongside v3)
_comment_scene_camera: VL-PSY.1: from [0,7.2,-8.5]->[0,0,7] fov 55 (the superseded naturalistic pose, which put a pale sky band across the top). Round 2 went to y=14 looking steeply down, which killed the sky but framed only ONE fold cell — no repetition visible. Round 3 backs off to y=10 / fov 52: several cells in frame so the symmetry can read, sky still out.
_comment_complexity_cost: VL-PSY.2: measured, not declared-by-hope. p95 @1920x1080 on M2 Pro = 21.9 ms (v9.4 baseline on the same probe = 14.7 ms). The previous 2.0 was never true for this preset — VL is the most expensive thing in the catalog and the scheduler should know it. Instrument: VLBudgetProbeTests.
